msg: It might be difficult choosing the gnome that gives the most mushrooms. I did notice that at the beginning purple, brown, blue, and orange were giving me the most mushrooms. Once I noticed that these colors were giving me less, I started picking the other colors paired with them. So, red, yellow, pink, and green started giving me more mushrooms. It switches often, so if you're not sure, keep choosing any color until you notice which one gives you more and stick with that. So for example, I gave you the colors above to follow, but for you it could be different colors. Red, brown, pink, and orange may give you the most mushrooms at the same time while the others don't. So just choose the gnomes until you figure out which four are giving more mushrooms. Once you notice they are giving you less, pick the opposite colored gnomes and thy should give you more mushrooms.
